<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">
  <iframe id="annotationFrame"  width="100%" height="800px"></iframe>
	
	<!---->
		 
	<script>
        console.log("✅ Script executed");

        if (typeof g_scratchpad === "undefined") {
            console.error("❌ g_scratchpad is not defined!");
        } else {
            var loginUrl = g_scratchpad.loginUrl;  // Supervisely Login URL
            var targetUrl = g_scratchpad.baseUrl;  // Annotation Page URL
			console.log(loginUrl + targetUrl);
            var frame = document.getElementById("annotationFrame");

            if (!frame) {
                console.error("❌ iframe element not found!");
            } else {
                console.log("✅ Loading annotation page...");
                frame.src = targetUrl;  // Load annotation tool first

                frame.onload = function () {
                    console.log("🔎 Checking session...");

                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (frame.src.includes("login")) {
                            console.log("🔄 Session expired, redirecting to login...");
                            frame.src = loginUrl;
                        } else {
                            console.log("✅ Session active, annotation tool loaded.");
                        }
                    }, 2000);
                };

                // Check login status, but stop after 10 attempts
                let attemptCount = 0;
                let maxAttempts = 10;
                var loginCheckInterval = setInterval(function () {
                    attemptCount++;

                    try {
                        let iframeWindow = frame.contentWindow;
                        let iframeDoc = iframeWindow ? iframeWindow.document : null;

                        if (!iframeDoc || !iframeDoc.body) {
                            throw new Error("Cannot access iframe document");
                        }

                        let pageText = iframeDoc.body.innerText || "";
                        let pageTitle = iframeDoc.title || "";

                        if (pageText.includes("Projects") || pageTitle.includes("Supervisely")) {
                            console.log("✅ User logged in, closing iframe...");
                            clearInterval(loginCheckInterval);
                            frame.remove(); // **Remove the iframe**
                        }
                    } catch (err) {
                        console.warn("⚠️ Error while checking login status:", err.message);

                        if (attemptCount >= maxAttempts) {
                            console.warn("⏹️ Stopping login check after 10 attempts.");
                            clearInterval(loginCheckInterval);
                        }
                    }
                }, 2000); // Check every 2 seconds
            }
        }
    </script>
    
</j:jelly>
